business_logic.description: Approve a partner application and issue the discount code and QR
business_logic.spec: Row action on SURZ_PARTNER (payload = the clicked row, flat; key PARTNER_ID). ADMIN ONLY: refuse with an error unless the caller holds the admin or func-admin role (use whatever caller identity the BL runtime exposes; if none is exposed, rely on the object edit right being granted only to those roles). Refuse unless STATUS = 'PENDING' (re-read the stored row; never trust the payload). Require DISCOUNT_PCT > 0 (and <= 100) OR a non-blank DISCOUNT_CODE that exists in SURZ_DISCOUNT; otherwise return an error. CASE A, DISCOUNT_CODE blank: generate a unique code 'SZP-' + first 4 letters of PARTNER_NAME (upper-case, letters only, padded with 'X' if shorter) + '-' + 2 random digits, retrying until SURZ_DISCOUNT has no row with that CODE; INSERT into SURZ_DISCOUNT (CODE, DESCR = 'Partner ' + PARTNER_NAME, PERCENT_OFF = DISCOUNT_PCT, MIN_ORDER = 0, IS_ACTIVE = 'Y', PARTNER_ID, PARTNER_NAME, USAGE_COUNT = 0, ADD_DATE/ADD_USER/CHG_DATE/CHG_USER audit stamps); write the code back to SURZ_PARTNER.DISCOUNT_CODE. CASE B, DISCOUNT_CODE given: it must exist in SURZ_DISCOUNT, and its PARTNER_ID must be NULL/blank or equal to this PARTNER_ID (else error 'code belongs to another partner'); UPDATE that discount row SET PARTNER_ID, PARTNER_NAME, IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'; and set SURZ_PARTNER.DISCOUNT_PCT from its PERCENT_OFF when DISCOUNT_PCT is blank. Then UPDATE SURZ_PARTNER SET STATUS = 'APPROVED', APPROVED_ON = now, APPROVED_BY = caller short id, QR_URL = 'https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=300x300&data=' + urllib-style percent-encoded DISCOUNT_CODE (sandbox has no import: encode with a small manual percent-encoder), REJECT_REASON = NULL, CHG_* audit. If REGISTRY_ID is blank, make a best-effort attempt to resolve it from the users/identity table by EMAIL; leave blank if not resolvable. Finally call api.emit_event('surz_partner_approved', {PARTNER_ID, PARTNER_NAME, ORG_NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, DISCOUNT_CODE, DISCOUNT_PCT, QR_URL, PORTAL_URL}) where PORTAL_URL is the shop/partner portal URL taken from project config or a sensible default; an emit failure is logged and must NOT roll back the approval (the writes persist). PARTNER ROLE: after STATUS is APPROVED and REGISTRY_ID is resolved, when REGISTRY_ID is non-blank call api.grant_role(REGISTRY_ID, 'partner'); a failure is logged and never rolls back the approval; a blank REGISTRY_ID is logged (role to be granted once the account is known). Return {'message': 'Partner approved. Code <CODE> issued.'}. Any validation failure returns {'error': '...'} and writes nothing.

business_logic.spec: Row action on SURZ_PARTNER (payload = the clicked row; key PARTNER_ID). ADMIN ONLY: refuse unless the caller holds admin or func-admin (same rule as surz_partner_approve). Re-read the stored row; refuse unless STATUS = 'PENDING'. REJECT_REASON must be non-blank (the admin saves it on the form first, then clicks Reject) else return an error. UPDATE SURZ_PARTNER SET STATUS = 'REJECTED', APPROVED_ON = NULL, APPROVED_BY = NULL, CHG_* audit. Optionally call api.emit_event('surz_partner_rejected', {PARTNER_ID, PARTNER_NAME, EMAIL, REJECT_REASON}); an emit failure is logged only. PARTNER ROLE: when REGISTRY_ID is non-blank call api.revoke_role(REGISTRY_ID, 'partner'); a failure is logged and never rolls back the rejection. Return {'message': 'Application rejected.'}.

validations.name: Only pending
validations.message: Only a PENDING application can be rejected.

business_logic.description: Server-stamp STATUS and APPLIED_ON on a new application
business_logic.spec: pre_commit on SURZ_PARTNER (shared by surz_partner_apply and surz_partner). Return immediately unless action is 'add'. The header row already exists on the save connection: UPDATE SURZ_PARTNER SET STATUS = 'PENDING' WHERE PARTNER_ID = <header PARTNER_ID / txn_id> AND (STATUS IS NULL OR STATUS = ''), and SET APPLIED_ON = current date WHERE APPLIED_ON IS NULL. Never overwrite a STATUS already present (never trust or accept an APPROVED/REJECTED arriving from a client on add: if the row was added by a non-admin caller force STATUS = 'PENDING' regardless). The form deliberately carries NO client defaults for these two columns so a blank Add form is not dirty. Return None on success; on any unexpected failure log and return {'error': 'Could not register the application'}.

Runs after commit; return immediately unless action is 'add'. Re-read the saved SURZ_PARTNER row by txn_id/PARTNER_ID and call api.emit_event('surz_partner_registered', {PARTNER_ID, PARTNER_NAME, ORG_NAME, BUSINESS_TYPE, EMAIL, PHONE, CITY, STATE_NAME, MESSAGE, APPLIED_ON}). The flow bound to that event sends (1) an acknowledgement email to the applicant (EMAIL) and (2) a heads-up to the admin mailbox. A missing row, missing EMAIL, or any failure (including an undefined event) is logged and swallowed: this hook must NEVER report a failure, the application is already committed.
